reference_definition: external reference Iref = 15u injected into the diode-connected Mref; theoretical unit current = 15u x (2.5/2)/(20/2)
failure_condition: en0 low, or any other branch conducting, or the branch current outside the candidate band, or a non-conducting branch whose local bias node is charged
